task: Independent checklist for transferred original PR2120 verify/status receipt

frontend_requests.comparison: Exact ordered label list independently derived from reviewed D intent and original verifier iteration; not count-only. Metadata has canonical/cache-busted requests for both Accept application/json and */*.

requirements: Timezone-aware ISO values; each observation >= original prepared_at minus300seconds and <= verification completion time plus300seconds.
boot_started_at equals first entry in nonempty deduplicated boot_started_at_observations.
One to three distinct boot values is allowed by original verifier; do not demand a single boot.
checks=3 is exact integer and means original three-probe loop completed. Full returned frontend label list describes the first probe; original code repeated all checks each time.

All shell content types begin text/html; cache-control includes no-cache,no-store,must-revalidate; immutable absent; max-age/s-maxage if present are <=0; Age if present is exactly0; no HIT,STALE,UPDATING cache status.
Each worker state retirement_payload_present, JavaScript MIME, cache-control additionally max-age=0; original guard also required nosniff and exact retirement bytes.
Returned cache and worker records are checked as structured output; original unchanged verifier execution supplies the byte/MIME checks omitted from compact stdout.

checks: Exact byte equality with copied original-lease-before.json, and exact A/J/D/RID/protocol fields.
No manual alteration/recreation/abort; inherited lease actor and original timestamp preserved.

execution_evidence: Fresh prelaunch absence of a running original verifier; exact original guard hash and current expected lease confirmed.
Capture original argv/start/end/exit code, complete unchanged stdout/stderr, byte counts and SHA256s.
Require original verify exit0 and parsed full JSON matching expected static fields, complete request list and dynamic records.
Only after verify ends, original status exit0 with active:false and no incomplete_lease_directory; lease directory absent afterward.
Rehash transferred originals locally against the host receipt. Wrapper PASS alone or UI completion alone is insufficient.
failure_classification: Wrapper PID/start is not proof that original verify began. Missing receipt alone is not proof it did not begin.
Initial parser SyntaxError is a wrapper parse failure if stderr proves it occurred before any execution and no original child/output evidence exists. Preserve it.
If original verify launched or output files exist, inspect its process/results before any retry. Never start a duplicate verifier.
An interrupted or failed wrapper after verify may still have a valid closed lease; inspect original stdout/status and actual state before further action.

calls: original production_release_guard.py status only after successful verify and matching stdout
runner_scope_review.writes: Only caller-owned stage receipt and exclusive stdout/stderr captures; original guard itself closes matching lease on success.
runner_scope_review.prelaunch_requirement: Run without -O/-OO and with PYTHONOPTIMIZE absent, because wrapper preconditions use assert. Use a new owned stage and preserve initial parse-failure artifacts.
